display.entryTitle: Produce Basket Apples and Beets Mickey

description: Out on the street in front of Good Boy! Grocers, a basket of fruit and vegetables has apples and beets arranged as a Mickey.

whereToLook.scene: The produce basket outside Good Boy! Grocers
whereToLook.exactSpot: The apples and beets in the basket. One large and two small, head and ears.

bestTip: It is at kid height, which is why kids find it first.
